head: <see final commit>

requirements.what_changed: Books.profit_and_loss reads orders_ingest.source_state (gate open AND a completed read audited). Sales reading measured|INCOMPLETE (lower bound)|UNMEASURED; when UNMEASURED every sales-derived field in to_dict (gross/net sales, fees, orders, customers, contribution, profit, cash, tax reserve) is None with sales_why, all_figures_observed False; operating cost stays measured. cfo_challenge and trajectory say UNMEASURED instead of CA$0.00 / 'no orders exist'. unit_economics customers None when unmeasured. Etsy fee entries referencing a receipt/transaction with no internal order open one idempotent reconciliation incident (finance.reconciliation.etsy_vs_orders).
requirements.consumer: /api/finance (app/main.py::api_finance via pl.to_dict), runtime/pipeline.py finance.reconcile / finance.challenge / plan.strategy handlers
requirements.live_root: GET /api/finance; cadenced finance.reconcile, finance.challenge, plan.strategy; commerce.orders_ingest (6h) for the incident
requirements.remaining: No reconciliation against monthly statements / payouts or future accounting integrations; no check that each internal order has a matching ledger entry after N days (the reverse disagreement).

requirements.what_changed: Additive LedgerEntry columns source, external_id, currency, amount_original (nullable), classification, basis, fees_basis, reconciliation_state (defaults unknown/unreconciled, so legacy rows never read as measured). Additive Order columns fees_basis, offsite_ads_fee_cad (None = not read). Ingest writes sale rows with source etsy_receipts, external_id, receipt currency/amount, classification sale, basis measured, fees_basis modelled, reconciliation_state unreconciled. P&L reports platform_fees_basis and platform_fees_by_basis {measured, modelled, unknown}; modelled fees make all_figures_observed False.
requirements.remaining: No writers for payouts, owner funding, subscriptions, adjustments; AI/model spend still lives only in cost_entries (not mirrored into the ledger).

requirements.what_changed: EtsyReceiptReader.ledger_entries reads getShopPaymentAccountLedgerEntries through the existing EtsyClient _require/_call (same scope refusal, transport, error taxonomy). After each ingest, finance.reconcile.apply classifies entries by ledger_type, matches fees to orders by reference_id (transaction-level to the line, receipt-level shared by price), and incrementally (entry ids stored on the order) replaces the modelled fee with the charged one: order and ledger row fees_basis -> measured, reconciliation_state matched_etsy_ledger|partial_etsy_ledger, contribution recomputed. Unclassified entries are reported, never counted. Readers without the method, or a failed read, leave fees modelled with the reason. Receipt status recorded; canceled/fully refunded receipts keep no revenue.
requirements.remaining: UNVERIFIED against a live shop: ledger_type strings and minor-unit amount (finance/reconcile.py LEDGER_AMOUNT_DIVISOR, _FEE_EXACT) must be checked on the first real read. Digital delivery state, buyer-issue linkage and case state are not reconciled. getShopPaymentByReceiptId (Payment amount_fees/adjusted) not used because it is absent from etsy_oauth.SCOPES_REQUIRED (cluster B).

requirements.what_changed: Ingest writes acquisition_source 'unknown' on customer and order. finance.sources.attribute is the one writer of a known source and refuses without evidence (history kept). finance.sources.record_first_sale writes OperatingReading commerce.first_sale once (never replaced by a later order), with source, channel, evidence and 'possibility, not scale' note, refreshed with history when evidence arrives (e.g. Offsite Ads fee).
requirements.consumer: OperatingReading commerce.first_sale; Order.acquisition_source read by order_readings loops, growth.mix, scale.evidence
requirements.remaining: Owner / Stats-export attribution route (sources.attribute is callable; no API route because app/main.py is cluster E).

requirements.what_changed: finance.sources.table: orders/revenue/contribution for etsy_organic, etsy_ads, offsite_ads, owned_direct and an explicit unattributed bucket (legacy 'etsy' maps to unattributed), total = sum of rows, unattributed_share. Exposed as profit_and_loss.sales_by_source in /api/finance (None when sales UNMEASURED).

An offsite_ads_fee ledger entry matched to an order sets Order.offsite_ads_fee_cad and offsite_ad_attributed, is included in the measured fee and deducted from contribution_cad, and attributes the order to offsite_ads with the entry id as evidence. Not read = None, never 0.
requirements.consumer: Order.contribution_cad / offsite_ad_attributed -> order_readings, growth_ops ads, sources.table
requirements.remaining: Live verification of the offsite fee ledger_type string (etsy_surfaces notes the ledger description enum may not name an ad fee).

requirements.what_changed: orders_ingest catches EtsyAuthNeedsOwner on the receipt read and the ledger read; needs_owner() classifies (refresh_refused, access_revoked, scope_drift, sealing_key_changed, no_credential) and upserts one OwnerAction etsy.oauth.reauthorise (restated when open, never reopened when done) plus one P2 incident etsy.oauth.needs_owner (report_count incremented). Run returns UNMEASURED, no orders.
requirements.remaining: Orders side only; publish side (runtime/pipeline.py::handle_store_publish) is another cluster.

requirements.what_changed: finance.sustainability.break_even: per product, creation cost = AI/API spend tagged to the product before its first live listing (floor), contribution per sale measured from orders or modelled at listed price (labelled), break_even_sales = ceil(creation/contribution), None with reason when contribution <= 0; maintenance so far kept separate as recurring.
requirements.remaining: Depends on product_slug tagging of cost rows; untagged product work is counted as platform spend.

requirements.what_changed: finance.sustainability.forecast: low/base/high named scenarios (catalogue size, sales/month, support rate, new products/month, platform factor) x measured unit costs (platform monthly spend, creation per product, maintenance per listing, support per case); refuses with INSUFFICIENT_DATA (<14 days history, <20 costed calls, no product-tagged creation cost, no priced listing), showing only the measured platform floor.
requirements.remaining: Scenario assumptions are constants in SCENARIOS; no owner-editable input.

requirements.what_changed: launch/readiness.assess gains 'sustainable_economics' (blocked_by build): ready only when the forecast computes and the base case nets positive with AI/API <= 50% of contribution; evidence carries status, problems, missing, scenario totals, measured inputs, low-case top-up flag and break-even per product.
requirements.remaining: With production's current development spend the gate may read blocked until spend is tagged/wound down; that is the intended behaviour.

requirements.what_changed: finance.sustainability.listing_maintenance_cost: AI/API spend tagged to a product after its first live listing, per listing per month; UNMEASURED with reason while no listing is live. Feeds the forecast.
requirements.remaining: Maintenance jobs (observation, revalidation, refresh, support) must pass product_slug to spend_report.record for attribution; live-at uses Listing.created_at as a floor (no published_at column).
Fix is in visual/reliability.py / publish/model_photography.py (not cluster D ownership): add judging cost to spent_cad as judging_cad.

tests_changed.why: Pinned CA$0.00/0 orders as observed with no order source connected; replaced by test_sales_are_unmeasured_not_zero_while_the_order_source_is_closed plus a measured-zero test with the source connected and read.
Pinned gross_sales_cad 0.0 and all_figures_observed True for a disconnected source; renamed ..._reports_unmeasured_sales_and_no_forecast and asserts UNMEASURED/None.
Asserted the etsy_organic loop was credited 43 orders from the blanket 'etsy' label; now asserts unattributed orders credit no loop and every ingested order is 'unknown'.
'A company that has done its half' now also records 30 days of measured AI/API spend so the new sustainable_economics requirement can compute; no assertion weakened.

migrations: ledger: +source VARCHAR(40) '' ,+external_id VARCHAR(120) '', +currency VARCHAR(3) 'CAD', +amount_original FLOAT NULL, +classification VARCHAR(40) '', +basis VARCHAR(12) 'unknown', +fees_basis VARCHAR(12) 'unknown', +reconciliation_state VARCHAR(24) 'unreconciled' (+indexes on source, external_id, reconciliation_state)
All via core/migrate.py additive ADD COLUMN + literal-default backfill; no data rewritten.
needs_from_others: Cluster B (integrations/etsy.py, etsy_oauth.py): add a public EtsyClient.get_payment_account_ledger_entries(min_created, max_created, limit, offset) so orders_ingest.EtsyReceiptReader.ledger_entries can stop calling client._call; add 'getShopPaymentByReceiptId': ('transactions_r',) (and getShopPaymentAccountLedgerEntry, getPaymentAccountLedgerEntryPayments) to SCOPES_REQUIRED so per-receipt Payment amount_fees/adjusted_fees can be read.

Cluster E (app/main.py api_finance + dashboard): docstring 'Every figure observed' is now false; render profit_and_loss.sales_reading/sales_why (show 'UNMEASURED' not CA$0.00 when gross_sales_cad is null), platform_fees_basis + platform_fees_by_basis (label modelled fees 'modelled, not charged'), and a traffic-source table from profit_and_loss.sales_by_source.channels with the 'unattributed' row always shown. Add POST route for owner/Stats attribution calling finance.sources.attribute(db, external_ref, source, evidence=..., by='owner') and GET for finance.sources.first_sale(db).

runtime/orders.py::handle_orders_ingest (owner unassigned in my brief): include got['fees'] (read, orders_measured, orphan_fee_entries, reconciliation_incident), got['first_sale'] and got['auth_failure'] in the commerce.orders_ingested audit summary.
Visual cluster: F-322 judging cost in visual/reliability.py.
Cost writers for maintenance jobs (observation/revalidation/support): pass product_slug to spend_report.record so F-321/F-324 attribution is not a floor.
risks: Etsy payment-account ledger field semantics (ledger_type values, amount units) are UNVERIFIED until transactions_r is granted; wrong guesses leave entries unclassified (reported) rather than miscounted, but a wrong divisor would misstate measured fees -- verify on first real read.
sustainable_economics may block launch in production because current platform spend includes R&D; intended per F-329 but the owner should expect it.
books.profit_and_loss now queries OAuthCredential/AuditLog on every call (small cost; used by handlers and /api/finance).
Order/ledger rows from before this change keep fees_basis 'unknown' and acquisition_source 'etsy' (mapped to unattributed in the table); none exist in production today (no transactions_r).
